source.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC not amenable to curative resection or radiation.
At least 1 measurable lesion as assessed by investigator per the RECIST v1.1 criteria for both cohorts.
Participants previously treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors or other T cell immune-modulating antibodies, including anti-CTLA-4, anti-PD-1 and/or anti-PD-L1 agents.

Active autoimmune or lung disease requiring systemic therapy (eg, with disease modifying drugs, prednisone \>10 mg daily or equivalent, immunosuppressant therapy) within 2 years prior to first ivonescimab dose

Unstable angina, myocardial infarction, congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association \[NYHA\] classification ≥ grade 2) or unstable vascular disease (eg, aortic aneurysm at risk of rupture, Moyamoya disease) that required hospitalization within 6 months prior to first ivonescimab dose
Any evidence of current ILD or pneumonitis or a prior history of ILD or non-infectious pneumonitis requiring systemic corticosteroids
Known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) whose viral load is not controlled.
Current use of systemic corticosteroids (\>10 mg daily prednisone or equivalent)
Known history of allogeneic organ transplantation or allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
Patient is breastfeeding or plans to breastfeed during the study
